_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Saying I wait for it instead of looking forward

items.en: I am looking forward to it

segments.text: I am looking forward to it.
It means, I am happy about something in the future.
Our trip is on Friday. I am looking forward to it!
Repeat after me. I am looking forward to it.

native.caption: Statt “I wait for it” sagt man auf Englisch “I am looking forward to it” – das heißt: Ich freue mich darauf. Beispiel: “Our trip is on Friday.” – “I am looking forward to it!”. Hör Ama zu und sprich in der Pause nach. Übe mehr in der Lexkite-App.

en.hook: How do you say “Ich freue mich darauf”?
en.caption: Instead of “I wait for it”, English speakers say “I am looking forward to it” – it means I am happy about something to come. Example: “Our trip is on Friday.” – “I am looking forward to it!”. Listen to Ama, then say it in the pause. Practice more in the Lexkite app.
